description: A lightweight ASP.NET Core web app that serves a local directory over HTTP or HTTPS with directory browsing enabled. Point it at a folder; browse it in any web browser.

release-target.reason: Releases are tagged vYYYY.M.D until the first release of 2027, the maintainer's decision: every 2026.Q.MMDD sorts below the published 2026.9.23, so release-target.cs, which computes that scheme, is adopted with the first release of 2027 (PROGRESS.md, AGENTS.md).
